verdict.rationale: Docs describe how skills execute (SKILL.md loaded into context, code execution environment for API skills, disableBundledSkills toggle) but nowhere document a security posture: no explicit trust model for vetting/sandboxing third-party skills, no permission/capability model beyond a simple on/off toggle, and no telemetry or data-collection disclosure tied to skills usage. The evidence pack contains no first-party or independent source addressing these safety-review concerns.
